plans_limits_positive.name: plans_limits_positive
plans_limits_positive.value: ("plans"."seat_limit" IS NULL OR "plans"."seat_limit" > 0) AND ("plans"."storage_gb_per_member" IS NULL OR "plans"."storage_gb_per_member" > 0)

plans_prices_nonnegative.name: plans_prices_nonnegative
plans_prices_nonnegative.value: ("plans"."price_monthly_satang" IS NULL OR "plans"."price_monthly_satang" >= 0) AND ("plans"."price_yearly_satang" IS NULL OR "plans"."price_yearly_satang" >= 0)

entitlement_overrides_expiry.name: entitlement_overrides_expiry
entitlement_overrides_expiry.value: "entitlement_overrides"."expires_at" IS NOT NULL OR "entitlement_overrides"."contract_ref" IS NOT NULL

support_tickets_requester.name: support_tickets_requester
support_tickets_requester.value: "support_tickets"."requester_user_id" IS NOT NULL OR "support_tickets"."requester_email" IS NOT NULL
